text: Conflicting accesses shall overlap storage footprints with at least one actual write. Across agents, unordered conflicting accesses with at least one non-atomic access shall constitute a data race, including mixed atomic/ordinary use. Ordinary writes between atomic phases shall remain ordered relative to conflicts.
